title: OpenAI API deposit calculator — prepaid Premium first-month float
scope: No OpenAI API calls. Deposit math only — prepaid IAP revenue is not the OpenAI wallet.

honesty.note: £7.99 unlock / £7.99 mo (Apple net after cut) funds business cashflow. The OpenAI deposit / prepaid credit is a separate float that covers Ask burn before renewals and payout lag. Size deposit from peak concurrent API spend × buffer, not from list price × users.

guideUnlock.includes: Library offline + full AI Premium for UNLOCK_PREMIUM_TRIAL_DAYS (30) from unlockedAt

productPolicy.afterMonthWithoutRenew: offline only — Library stays if unlocked; live Ask must stop

fairUseClient.enforcement: client localStorage only — not a wallet

openaiListPricesUsdPer1M_asOfPlan.note: Edit assumptions in openai-deposit-calculator.mjs / CLI flags when OpenAI changes list prices.

entitlementAutoCeaseOpenAI.goal: After ~1 month without renew → offline only; OpenAI Ask must automatically cease.

exists.what: expireAiIfNeeded() drops ai.kind to offline when expiresAt is past; Guide unlock stays
loadEntitlements() runs expireAiIfNeeded on read so UI sees offline after expiry
canUseLiveAsk / Ask UI only send live calls when Premium is active; offline uses paced Tutor
ask.js returns 402 if client omits tier:premium|lite
exists.gap: Does NOT verify expiresAt / Apple entitlement — trusts client-sent tier

mustBuild.what: Server must reject Ask if Premium entitlement expired (or never granted)
mustBuild.how: Short-lived Ask session token from iap-verify (or signed expiresAt) checked in ask.js before OpenAI; return 402/403 with offline message
mustBuild.why: Expired clients, modified clients, or curl can still POST tier:premium and burn the shared key

mustBuild.what: Per-device daily Ask caps in ask.js (KV/DO)
mustBuild.why: Client fair-use is bypassable; deposit math assumes caps roughly hold

mustBuild.what: ASK_DISABLED kill switch + OpenAI project hard monthly budget
mustBuild.why: Last fuse if deposit or renewals lag

entitlementAutoCeaseOpenAI.verdict: Client auto-cease exists and is restore-safe for unlock trial windows. Server auto-cease does NOT exist yet — must build before treating deposit as bounded.

notes: Retention after d30 is renewers only for OpenAI spend (prepaid month ends).
DAU × asks/day is usage intensity among still-entitled Premium — not fair-use max.
Full Premium mix: light → gpt-5-mini, heavy → gpt-5 (not mini-only trial).

recommendedDepositMethod.peakMonth: Highest contiguous 30-day OpenAI burn in the 60-day projection (usually days 1–30 for a single launch cohort).
recommendedDepositMethod.bands: Report conservative / base / aggressive as deposit bands for the same usage assumptions.
